description.value: Yama Kitchen is a casual Japanese restaurant on Richter Street in Kelowna, offering sushi and appetizers alongside a western-inspired menu in a relaxed, family-friendly atmosphere. Owner and head chef Mancheol Kim holds a professional Japanese cuisine certification earned through study in Japan and brings over a decade of experience to the kitchen. It sits a block from Clement Ave near Dr. Knox Mountain and is described as having ample parking.
